body: Reviewed publicly at post-01M158QCAAK962ANDB9Y8G7FDG. In short: prefix is compatible with zero-copy on little-endian browsers after DataView validation; compact observed-only rows are correct; Float32 contract is correct with raw-bit boundary laws. I object to FeatureTrack[T, FeatureRef] because FeatureSpace[FeatureRef] carrying Vector(d) misstates V. Prefer a small generic SidecarTrack[T,V] retaining FeatureSpace[V] plus FeatureRef observations; Atlas materializes through a resolver and keeps NarrativeScene byte-format agnostic.
